prompt: What can someone do after missing the refund deadline?
promptZh: 錯過退款期限後仍可做什麼？

options.text: Move the booking to another workshop date
options.zh: 將預約改到另一個工作坊日期
options.whyZh: 公告允許把名額轉給另一人，沒有說可更改日期。

options.text: Transfer the booking to another person
options.whyZh: 文件明確允許期限後轉讓。

options.text: Require the studio to deliver the samples at no charge
options.zh: 要求工作室免費配送品飲樣品

explanationZh: 文件明確允許期限後轉讓。
evidence: After that deadline, you may transfer your place to another person

vocabulary.note: 食物或飲品散發的氣味。
讓另一人代替原報名者參加。
